title: Learning Lean Feedback for Efficient Proof-Candidate Evaluation on GPUs
abstract: arXiv:2610.21881v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training language models for formal theorem proving requires large numbers of verifier calls. Slow checks and timeouts often leave GPUs waiting and withhold rewards from potentially correct proofs. We train neural evaluators to predict Lean 4 verdicts and compiler feedback on GPUs using 4.84M labelled programs. We compare two validity classifiers with a feedback model that annotates proof attempts with predicted goal states and error messages. A two-stage evaluator that screens candidates with a classifier and scores its positive predictions with the feedback model reaches 87.8% accuracy in predicting whether Lean accepts a candidate proof, evaluated on a 68,932-program benchmark collected from public provers. The combined evaluator processes 3.5 candidates per second on one H100, 4.2x the throughput of our 64-worker Lean baseline with environment reuse. translated_title: 在GPU上学习Lean反馈以实现高效的候选证明评估
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.21881v1 公告类型：新论文。摘要：训练用于形式化定理证明的语言模型需要大量验证器调用。缓慢的检查和超时常常使GPU处于等待状态，并使潜在正确的证明无法获得奖励。我们使用484万个标注程序训练神经评估器，在GPU上预测Lean 4的判定结果和编译器反馈。我们比较了两个有效性分类器与一个反馈模型，后者用预测的目标状态和错误信息为证明尝试进行标注。一个两阶段评估器先用分类器筛选候选证明，再用反馈模型对其正预测进行评分，在一个从公开证明器收集的包含68,932个程序的基准上，预测Lean是否接受候选证明的准确率达到87.8%。该组合评估器在单块H100上每秒处理3.5个候选证明，吞吐量是我们带环境复用的64工作者Lean基线的4.2倍。最后，我们将该评估器与Lean判定相结合，构建了一个混合奖励系统。
tldr: 该论文训练神经评估器在GPU上预测Lean 4的判定结果与编译器反馈，其两阶段评估器达到87.8%的预测准确率，吞吐量比Lean验证基线提升4.2倍，显著加速了形式化定理证明中语言模型训练的奖励评估过程。
en_tdlr: This paper trains neural evaluators to predict Lean 4 verdicts and compiler feedback on GPUs, achieving 87.8% accuracy with a two-stage evaluator and 4.2x higher throughput than the Lean verification baseline, significantly accelerating reward evaluation for training language models in formal theorem proving.
